title: The Day of Two Conversations at Once
skyStory: Still full, ninety-eight percent, and the moon is chattering away in Gemini like it had three coffees after last night's party. Gemini moons talk with both hands and both sides of the mouth. Expect overlapping conversations, crossed messages and somebody calling you by the wrong name with total confidence. It is all affectionate. The twins are just very, very excited.

reading: Two conversations will happen at once today, and you will try to win both. Gemini thinks this is hilarious. Life Path 3 can absolutely talk to two people, but listening to two people is a separate skill, and today the sky is grading listening.

Around 12:30 someone will tell a story that goes on too long. Do not jump in with your own better story, even though yours has a plot twist and a sound effect. Ask them one question about theirs instead. Their face will light up like the moon last night. Save your story for Nancy later; she will appreciate the twist.
joel.mission: Ask three people today a question you have never asked them before, and remember all three answers.
joel.omen: Two identical cars parked nose to nose. A conversation is about to become a duet; harmonise.

reading: Gemini is the storyteller's moon and your hands have been waiting all week for this. Today someone will ask, almost casually, 'so what happened?' and you will get to tell the whole thing, with voices, pauses and a dramatic reveal.

The Rat's trick: tell it twice. Once to someone who already knows the ending, so you can enjoy their laugh at your favourite part. Once to someone brand new, so you can watch the surprise land. Two audiences, one story, full Gemini energy. The [[Page of Cups]] has a fish popping out of its cup and is just as surprised as everyone else.
nancy.mission: Tell your best story of the week to two different people, and change one tiny detail the second time.
nancy.omen: A crow or any bird that seems to be talking back. Someone wants to hear more from you.

together.text: Have a conversation entirely in questions. Every message must be a question. First one to accidentally write a statement loses and must send a dramatic apology in the style of a medieval herald. Gemini is refereeing and has no mercy.
